_readme: Hand labels for scripts/eval_events.py. Frame numbers are absolute frame indexes of data/cfr/tran04_cam1.mp4 (60 fps). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Fill the three lists, then: python scripts/eval_events.py ../data/cfr/tran04_cam1.mp4
_hits: frame the racket touches the shuttle. Detections come up to one TrackNet stride (8 frames) later, so +-12 frames are tolerated by default.
_smashes: the hit frame of each smash (also list it under hits).
_landings: first frame the shuttle touches the floor; 'call' is the true line call for that landing (IN, OUT) or null when unsure.
